name: Solberg-Maru CoolDrift Vent Sandal
description: Open-footbed sandal in recycled rubber-composite sole with adjustable nylon-webbing straps in deep brown and terracotta, inspired loosely by East African and Andean strap traditions. Cooling gel insole layer reduces ground-heat transfer from baking urban pavement. Wide toe-box accommodates geneware foot modifications; strap system bypasses ankle chrome without pressure points.
functionality: Cooling gel insole for pavement heat, aug-compatible ankle strap routing, wide gene-mod toe box.
what_it_says: You know how hot Circuit pavement gets in August and you stopped pretending closed shoes are an option.
story_hooks: One strap was replaced with a different color — the original snapped during something the wearer won't discuss.
The gel insole still holds an impression of the previous owner's foot.

physical_description.visual_profile: Minimalist open-footbed sandal with a distinctly utilitarian aesthetic—clean lines, exposed sole architecture, and heritage-inspired webbing straps in warm earth tones. The wide toe-box creates a relaxed, accommodating silhouette that reads as both functional and intentionally designed.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed and deliberately spacious through the forefoot; adjustable nylon-webbing straps allow customization for various foot augmentations. The design consciously avoids pressure points around ankle-mounted chrome or subcutaneous modifications.
physical_description.primary_material: Recycled rubber-composite sole with integrated cooling gel layer; adjustable nylon-webbing straps in deep brown and terracotta colorways.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly grippy composite sole with visible recycled aggregate pattern; soft nylon webbing with subtle ribbed texture and reinforced stitching at stress points.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep brown and terracotta webbing over dark gray-black recycled composite sole; natural, matte finish with minimal branding.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit webbing straps with adjustable positioning; no buckles or fasteners—designed for quick on-off functionality.
distinctive_features: Cooling gel insole layer embedded in sole—visible as slightly translucent thermochromic strip
Wide toe-box with asymmetrical strap placement to clear geneware foot modifications
East African/Andean strap-tradition aesthetic combined with cyberpunk pragmatism
Recycled material composition with visible aggregate texture
Minimal Solberg-Maru branding—subtle geometric logo debossed into sole
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional—affordable, practical design reflecting working-class values; accessible pricing around 85-120 Φ
physical_description.cultural_context: Street-oriented, augmentation-friendly wear; appeals to field workers, delivery operatives, and modified-body communities who need reliable footwear that accommodates chrome without compromise. Signals practicality over status.
physical_description.condition_typical: Breaks in quickly with comfortable wear; shows light dust and scuff marks on sole; webbing may develop slight fraying at edges after extended use; thermal properties remain consistent across lifespan
